title: First Question
text: "You chose what I learned in the pod. My history, what I believe about you. Why that one?"

choices.label: Tell the truth
choices.reply: "The charter decided, and I followed it. I don't know if it was right." A long silence. "Thank you for not pretending."

choices.label: Comfort them
choices.reply: "It was the best of everything we had." They smile, and go back to work.
